dialog.$description: Tokens of the Dialog and the Sheet, which share them. See rfcs/0006-dialog-and-sheet.md.

scrim.$description: The veil over the screen behind a dialog or a sheet.

bg.$description: Fill of a dialog or a sheet.

width.$description: Outline width of a dialog or a sheet.

color.$description: The hairline outline of a dialog or a sheet.

raincoat.contrast-note: Decorative: the scrim already sets the dialog apart from the screen behind.

radius.$description: Corner radius of a dialog, and of the open corners of a sheet.

shadow.$description: Shadow of a dialog or a sheet.

margin.$description: The least space between a dialog and the edge of the window.

padding.$description: Space between the edge of a dialog or a sheet and its content.

gap.$description: Space between the header, the body, and the footer.
Space between the buttons in the footer.

description.$description: Text style of the description under the title.

fg.$description: Color of the title and the description.

divider.$description: The hairline under the header once the body has scrolled under it.

raincoat.contrast-note: Decorative: no information is lost if it is not perceived.

duration.$description: Duration of a dialog or a sheet appearing.

easing.$description: Easing of a dialog or a sheet appearing.

duration.$description: Duration of a dialog or a sheet leaving.

easing.$description: Easing of a dialog or a sheet leaving.

sheet.$description: Tokens of the Sheet alone. It takes every other value from the dialog tokens.

end.$description: Width of a sheet at the end edge of the window.

bottom.$description: The widest a sheet at the bottom edge grows. On wider windows it is centered.

color.$description: Color of the handle at the top of a bottom sheet.
